title: Agent Certificate v0 Evidence References
description: Typed, bounded, unique evidence references for Agent Certificate v0 claims (build-item B1 work order: 'typed, bounded, unique evidence references'). An evidence reference binds a claim to a committed artifact by kind + digest; it never carries content, counts, free text, or arbitrary map keys. Root instance is one EvidenceRefV0.

EvidenceKindV0.description: Closed evidence-kind vocabulary for v0. Each kind names the artifact family the digest commits to; adding a kind is a new compatible schema release with its own Disclosure Register entry (C1 Ruling 1 reversal condition). `audit_report_digest` was added SCHEMA-1, 2026-08-24 (gap C4) as a DISTINCT kind from the pre-existing generic `verifier_report_digest`: it names specifically the digest of one typed, content-free certificate_audit_report_v0_schema.json#/definitions/AuditReportV0 record — build session, private client-evidence-manifest root, ledger seal, compiler/schema/semantics/verifier identities, and bounded per-claim support/abstention rows — never an unstructured verifier-output blob. `client_commitment_digest` is the G1-only kind for a client-held commitment root; it proves only that the client presented that commitment at commit time, not a verifier report, truth, authorship, or completeness. `verifier_report_digest` remains available for other, non-audit-report verifier evidence.

EvidenceRefV0.description: One typed evidence reference: kind + commitment digest + optional opaque locator. The digest is the binding; the locator is an operational convenience only — 'verification must not depend exclusively on mutable rows remaining present' (C6 Ruling 1), so a resolvable locator is never required for the reference to be well-formed.

evidence_ref.description: Optional opaque operational locator (server- or issuer-assigned). Presence is a disclosure of existence and cardinality, registered in the issuer->relying-party Disclosure Register section.
